name: Olympic Movement (1986–2010)
description: A white field charged at the centre with five rings — blue, yellow, black, green and red — in two rows, drawn with white gaps where the rings cross.
history: The 1986 version of the Olympic rings added white trim so that the rings appeared separated where they crossed. In 2010 the IOC restored the original fully interlaced rings, which appear on the current flag.

features.role: five rings in blue, yellow, black, green and red with gaps at the crossings
features.symbolism: the five inhabited continents united by Olympism
